Lemma
[An Orthonormal Tuple is Nondegenerate]

↗ lem:nondegenerate-tuple-leading-minors

Every orthonormal tuple in a scalar product space is nondegenerate.

Proof

↗ lem:nondegenerate-tuple-leading-minors \sketch Each leading Gram matrix is diagonal with entries $\pm 1$, so every leading determinant is nonzero. Apply Lemma 16.3.

□
